visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with short black hair and a grey button-down shirt sits in front of a grey curtain background. He holds a yellow and red snack packet with Japanese text and an illustration of a mascot. He carefully opens the package, reveals a light-colored oval cracker, and places it in his mouth. His facial expression shifts from curiosity to wide-eyed surprise, his hand covering his mouth. (2) The scene cuts to a woman with glasses wearing a black sleeveless top sitting at a desk with a smartphone in front of her. She holds a similar yellow wrapper and eats a cracker, reacting with an exaggerated expression of shock, her eyes widening and mouth opening. Behind her are wooden shelves packed with various consumer goods and boxes. (3) The scene cuts to another young man in a black t-shirt in a similar indoor environment with office-like shelves. He takes a bite of the cracker, chews thoughtfully, and then displays a shocked, impressed facial expression, nodding his head while his eyes remain wide. Yellow graphic star icons appear around his head. (4) The first man returns, showing the product box which is white with red and black text and an image of sliced beef. He points to the text on the box while speaking to the camera in a brightly lit indoor studio setting.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Fast-paced electronic pop music starts immediately. A male voice speaks with high energy and clarity. A sharp plastic rustling sound occurs as a package is opened, followed by a crisp, high-frequency 'crunch' sound of a bite. (2) A female voice enters with a high-pitched exclamation of surprise, accompanied by a cartoonish 'ding' sound effect. The BGM remains steady with a synthesized beat. (3) A second male voice speaks with a lower pitch but rising intonation, expressing disbelief. Another crunching sound is clearly heard over the music. (4) The original male voice returns, speaking rapidly with various high-arousal interjections. Brief laughing sounds from background individuals are audible. The BGM concludes with a final synthesized chord.

It uses high-energy reactions from different people to validate the claim that the snack tastes remarkably like real beef, creating a sense of curiosity and amusement.
